noise_models.construction: DEP at kappa = 1 plus symmetric readout error p_ro on every qubit. SHOT pipeline: ReadoutError([[1-p_ro, p_ro],[p_ro, 1-p_ro]]) via add_all_qubit_readout_error. DM pipeline: readout noise attached only to the measurement instruction cannot alter pre-measurement density-matrix expectation values, so the DM value is obtained by extracting the computational-basis probability vector from the density matrix, applying the classical transition matrix (tensor product of the per-qubit 2x2 readout matrix) to it, and evaluating every observable from the transformed probabilities; kappa = 1 only

noise_models.name: IBM-calibration-derived (NoiseModel.from_backend on the Phase 2C pre-run calibration snapshot)
noise_models.construction: offline reconstruction from the saved Phase 2C pre-run snapshot: per chain qubit, thermal_relaxation(T1, T2, instruction duration) composed with depolarizing calibrated so the total average gate error equals the reported gate error for that instruction on those qubits; readout = per-qubit asymmetric matrix [[1-P(1|0), P(1|0)],[P(0|1), 1-P(0|1)]]; SHOT: channels by instruction/qubits + ReadoutError; DM: gate channels + classical readout transformation of the probability vector (as RO, asymmetric per qubit); chain layout by the deterministic path rule (prereg §4.2) for each L in {4,6,8}; representation and algorithm = future implementation contract in contract §C4; kappa = 1 only; blocked until the snapshot exists; native-gate translation: reconstructed channel of the device's native 2q gate on physical bond (chain[i-1], chain[i]) (larger-error direction) attached to the simulator cx on logical (q_{i-1}, q_i); sx/x/sxdg channels from the physical qubit's sx/x calibration; rz clean; readout per physical qubit; T6-style check that every executed instruction has a channel, else CAL_MISSING_CHANNEL and the cell is not run; stand-in on the simulator basis, not a model of the device decomposition

folding_variants.LOCAL: fold_gates_at_random on the transpiled circuit with fidelities={'single':1.0,'double':0.99} and bound seed (design.md §10, carried forward)
folding_variants.GLOBAL: fold_global on the operation list without final measurements (appended after folding; no barriers): q, f = divmod(lambda-1, 2); U -> U (U^dag U)^q, then suffix of n_p = round(f*|U|/2) operations (Python round, half to even) folded once; integer folds fold every operation, the partial fold folds only the suffix; inverses cx->cx, x->x, sx->sxdg (noisy), rz(t)->rz(-t) (clean); lambda_r on cx count (abscissa) and lambda_r^(1) on noisy 1q gates recorded separately; duplicate abscissas allowed and kept as recorded; fewer distinct realized abscissas than phase2b.rank_rule requires (LIN 2, QUAD 3, EXP 3) -> FIT_FAILURE for that extrapolator; deterministic across seeds (zero seed spread reported as such); full arithmetic in contract §C4

extrapolators.QUAD: PolyFactory(order=2)-equivalent degree-2 OLS intercept on lambda_r; Richardson (degree 4 through 5 points) rejected as ill-conditioned; QUAD is the declared 'Richardson or quadratic' option
extrapolators.EXP: ExpFactory-equivalent (pinned mitiq v1.0.0: sign from the linear intercept, sqrt-shifted weights in log mode, 1e-6 clamp, avoid_log = scipy curve_fit of a + b exp(c x) from [sign, -1] with RuntimeError as the only failure) with declared asymptote: 0 for ZPI and MLOC (traceless) and for the raw moments <Z_i>, <Z_j>, <Z_i Z_j> (each traceless); 2^-L for PRET. CZZ is never extrapolated directly: all three moments are extrapolated separately (moment-wise) with every extrapolator and CZZ is formed from the extrapolated moments; the same moment-wise rule applies to LIN and QUAD so that CZZ is well defined under all three. Asymptote limitation: the maximally mixed values are facts; convergence to them is an ansatz that holds as a fixed point only for DEP; under DEPH (populations preserved) and AMP (non-unital, fixed point |0...0>) the fixed-asymptote exponential is a shape assumption with no endpoint guarantee and its estimates are labelled 'fixed-asymptote ansatz'. Rank rule (phase2b.rank_rule, C-EXP-MIN-2B; amendment A-1, 2026-09-08): >= 3 distinct realized abscissas everywhere in Phase 2B, else FIT_FAILURE. Sign convention (amendment A-2, 2026-09-08): sign = np.sign(-(asymptote - numpy.polyfit(lambda_r, y, 1)[-1])), zero at equality, in log mode and as the avoid_log initial guess alike; never a '>= 0' ternary and never a closed-form intercept

peak_definition.quantity: sigma_O * O(n) on the noiseless E_0 grid, sigma_O = revival_polarity
peak_definition.local_max_rule: y[n] > y[n-1] and y[n] >= y[n+1], n in 2..N-1; n=1 and n=N never peaks

peak_definition.interpolation: parabolic through (n-1,n,n+1): t* = n + 0.5*(y[n-1]-y[n+1])/(y[n-1]-2y[n]+y[n+1]); failure (denominator >= 0 or |t*-n| > 1) -> t* = n, flagged
peak_definition.matching_window: [n_k - w, n_k + w] clipped to [1,N]; edge maximum -> NO_INTERIOR_PEAK
peak_definition.schedule_source: noiseless E_0 only, fixed before any noisy value
peak_definition.revival_identity: k defined on the ZPI schedule; PRET (and MLOC) peak k = the accepted peak inside window W_k; none or more than one -> NO_SCHEDULED_PEAK -> condition UNAVAILABLE for all combinations
peak_definition.window_uniqueness: if n_{k+1} - n_k < 9, windows truncated at the midpoint (W_k upper = floor((n_k+n_{k+1}-1)/2), W_{k+1} lower = ceil((n_k+n_{k+1}+1)/2)), WINDOW_TRUNCATED; width < 3 -> UNAVAILABLE; disjoint windows so one observed peak never serves two revivals
peak_definition.ed_identity: ED peak for revival k = the accepted ED peak inside W_k; none or more than one -> ED_PEAK_UNAVAILABLE for the ED-referenced metrics; never relabelled; E0 endpoints unaffected

cal_reconstruction.pinned_implementation: qiskit-aer 0.17.2, qiskit_aer.noise.device.models (_device_depolarizing_error, _device_thermal_relaxation_error, _combine_depol_and_relax_error), pinned in requirements-phase2.txt; read-only verified 2026-09-07 by the an independent reviewer against the public 0.17.2 source
cal_reconstruction.depolarizing_parameter: p = d (r_target - (1 - F_rel)) / (d F_rel - 1), d = 2^k, r_target = reported average gate infidelity capped at d/(d+1), F_rel = average fidelity of the thermal-relaxation channel alone for the instruction duration; p capped at d^2/(d^2-1)
cal_reconstruction.infeasible_policy: if r_target <= 1 - F_rel then p = 0 (no negative depolarization); the instruction is flagged CAL_RELAX_EXCEEDS_REPORTED, both the reported and the reconstructed infidelity are recorded per instruction, and the cell still runs (not blocking)
cal_reconstruction.t2_rule: T2 truncated to min(T2, 2 T1) with flag CAL_T2_TRUNCATED when it applies
cal_reconstruction.composition_order: depol_error.compose(relax_error): depolarizing applied first, then thermal relaxation, on the instruction's qubits in the target's qubit order
cal_reconstruction.reported_vs_reconstructed: recorded per (instruction, qubits) in control-free diagnostics of the cell log (B-CELLLOG row flags) and in provenance
cal_reconstruction.missing_channel_rule: exempt: rz (declared clean), measure (handled by the readout matrix), reset and barrier (no channel by design); every other executed instruction name/qubit tuple in every folded circuit must have a reconstructed channel, else CAL_MISSING_CHANNEL and the cell is not run

bootstrap.unit: the per-circuit shot record (multinomial resampling of recorded counts)
bootstrap.seed: numpy default_rng([20260907, phase, cell_index, b]); phase 2 = 2B, 3 = 2C (cell_index 0); circuits iterated in ascending (n, seed_index, scale_index)
bootstrap.interval: equal-tailed percentile, numpy quantile method='linear': h = q(B-1), x_(floor h + 1) + (h - floor h)(x_(floor h + 2) - x_(floor h + 1)); interpolated ranks, not exact order statistics
bootstrap.not_resampled: fold seeds (fixed design factor; their spread is the seed-spread band)
bootstrap.undefined_replicates: never dropped; all at -inf for the lower quantile, all at +inf for the upper; extended-real interpolation; infinite endpoint -> UNDEFINED -> INDETERMINATE; exact tolerated counts 4 / 12 / 49 (see C-UNDEF-RULE); primary tail probability exactly 1/9600 (rendered 1.0417e-4; the rounded value is never computed with)
bootstrap.coverage_caveat: approximate and conditional; unknown finite-sample coverage for the argmax-selected peak and the 3-point timing
bootstrap.hardware_assumption: exchangeability of a circuit's shots is an assumption on hardware; omitted variability: drift between/within circuits, non-stationary or correlated errors, calibration change; snapshots do not establish it; all hardware coverage statements conditional on it
estimator_order: per circuit: raw ZPI, PRET, <Z_i*>, <Z_i*+1>, <Z_i* Z_i*+1> from counts and actual shots

per fold seed: LIN/QUAD/EXP fits per raw quantity over that seed's (lambda_r, value) points with the rank minima of the phase (Phase 2B: phase2b.rank_rule, LIN 2, QUAD 3, EXP 3 distinct realized abscissas, amendment A-1; Phase 2C: phase2c.transpilation.rank_rule, LIN 2, QUAD 3, EXP 2) and per-seed EXP clamp rule

numerical_tolerances.cross_platform_note: design.md §16 1e-12 tested once and failed (run 34063462240); unchanged; no cause proposed; Phase 2 relies on eta_E = 1e-9 for DM-derived values and bit identity of shot records on the same Aer build

statistics.deviation_procedure: prereg §6.11: results/phase2/deviations.md entries before continuing; confirmatory -> exploratory on any confirmatory-rule deviation

physical_bounds.mitigated_and_replicates: never clipped, replaced or excluded; plug-in outside closed range -> UNPHYSICAL_ESTIMATE; replicates outside counted; interval extending outside -> UNPHYSICAL_INTERVAL
physical_bounds.effect_on_pass: PASS requires decision interval inside the closed band AND inside the closed physical range; UNPHYSICAL_INTERVAL never passes (FAIL if disjoint from the band, else OVERLAP)

statistics.percentile_justification: exactly recomputable from saved replicates; no variance estimate or jackknife; within the replicate range; well defined (degenerate) for constant replicates. NOT claimed: commutation with nonlinear monotone transforms; staying within the physical range

reproduction_scopes.reanalysis_of_saved_observations: deterministic; byte-identical analysis outputs in the same environment; per-quantity rules across platforms
reproduction_scopes.simulator_reacquisition: DM values to eta_E on any platform; shot records byte-identical on the same Aer build given seed_simulator; statistical across builds
reproduction_scopes.hardware_reacquisition: not reproducible; new calibration/usage/timestamps/provenance; only reanalysis of saved counts is reproducible
reproduction_scopes.per_quantity: r, A, I via §3.6 propagation; other derived quantities recomputed by the frozen order from inputs (DM values to eta_E; counts/seeds/schedule byte-identical); discrete disagreement -> REPRO_AMBIGUOUS with both results, never resolved by choice
